profile.name: Thorlabs APT电机控制器
profile.description: 用于驱动 Thorlabs APT 兼容电动位移台、旋转台等精密运动机构的控制器，可执行回零、绝对/相对移动、点动及位置与状态读取，常用于光学实验中的精密定位、对准和扫描。
profile.description_en: A controller for Thorlabs APT-compatible motorized stages, rotation stages, and other precision motion mechanisms. It supports homing, absolute/relative moves, jog motion, and position/status readback, and is commonly used for precise positioning, alignment, and scanning in optical experiments.
